# vcp_llm_connection (Resource)

Connects the LLM service to the project. A project has one connection: connecting creates the first group (`group_name`) with its first access key (`first_key_name`), checks the funds and issues the service license. On a project that is already connected the resource takes the existing connection into the state without calling the API, and `group_name` and `first_key_name` are not applied.

~> The service cannot be disconnected: `terraform destroy` only removes the connection from the state, the project stays connected. The first group and key are not managed by this resource — import them as `vcp_llm_group` and `vcp_llm_access_key` to manage them.

The resource needs only the LLM permission of the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connect the project to the LLM service. On a project that is already
# connected the existing connection is taken into the state as is.
resource "vcp_llm_connection" "this" {
  group_name     = "default"
  first_key_name = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `first_key_name` (String) Name of the first access key of the first group, issued by the connection. Applied only when the project is connected: changing it afterwards is refused at plan time.
- `group_name` (String) Name of the first group, created by the connection. Applied only when the project is connected: changing it afterwards is refused at plan time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the project the connection belongs to.
- `state` (String) Connection state: `connecting` or `connected`. New states may be added over time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The connection is imported by the ID of the project the provider key belongs to.
terraform import vcp_llm_connection.this 12345
```
